description: Kitesurf, self-hosted — unofficial Docker distribution of Cloudflare's headless browser engine for AI agents. CDP + token auth + REST actions (screenshot/pdf/markdown) + MCP tools, all in one container.

latest_release.body:
Docker images built from upstream [kitesurf 2026.11.11](https://github.com/cloudflare/kitesurf/releases/tag/2026.11.11).

| image | pull |
|---|---|
| auth — REST actions + token auth + optional TLS | `docker pull terry2010/surfbird:auth-2026.11.11` |
| raw — engine + CDP only | `docker pull terry2010/surfbird:raw-2026.11.11` |

Floating tags `raw` / `auth` / `latest` point at this build.
Unofficial distribution — not affiliated with Cloudflare.

detail.readme:
# Surfbird

**English** | [中文](README.zh-CN.md) **Kitesurf, self-hosted.** An unofficial Docker distribution of [Cloudflare Kitesurf](https://github.com/cloudflare/kitesurf) — the experimental browser engine built for AI agents. > Not affiliated with or endorsed by Cloudflare. Kitesurf is Apache-2.0 licensed. Kitesurf parses HTML, applies CSS, runs page JavaScript and renders screenshots — no Chrome, no browser container — and speaks CDP, so Puppeteer/Playwright connect as usual. Upstream only supports `wrangler dev` locally or deploying to Cloudflare Workers (paid). Surfbird packages it for any VPS. ## Images | Tag | Contents | Use | |---|---|---| | `terry2010/surfbird:raw` | engine only, `:8787` | local / behind your own gateway | | `terry2010/surfbird:auth` | engine + token auth proxy + optional TLS, `:8080` | one-command, exposed | | `terry2010/surfbird:latest` | = `:auth` | convenience default | Images auto-build daily when upstream cuts a new tag; per-tag pins like `terry2010/surfbird:auth-2026.11.8` are also published. ## Quick start ```bash # raw — engine only, no auth. Bind loopback/internal only! docker run -d -p 127.0.0.1:8787:8787 terry2010/surfbird:raw # auth — one command, token + REST actions docker run -d -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -e SURFBIRD_TOKEN=$(openssl rand -hex 24) terry2010/surfbird:auth ``` ## Usage **CDP (Puppeteer / Playwright / chrome-devtools-mcp):** ```js puppeteer.connect({ browserWSEndpoint: "ws://:8787/devtools/browser", // raw // or auth image: browserWSEndpoint: "ws://:8080/devtools/browser", headers: { Authorization: "Bearer " }, }); ``` **REST (auth image only):** ```bash curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ -d '{"url":"https://zhuikan.com/repos/terry2010__surfbird","fullPage":true}' \ http://:8080/screenshot -o page.png curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ -d '{"url":"https://zhuikan.com/repos/terry2010__surfbird"}' \ http://:8080/markdown | jq -r .markdown ``` Endpoints: `POST /screenshot | /pdf | /content | /source | /markdown | /evaluate | /batch` (one action over up to `MAX_BATCH_URLS` urls, per-item results), `GET /health`, `GET /openapi.json`. `/content` returns the post-JS rendered DOM; `/source` returns the original response body ("view source"). All other paths transparently proxy to the engine (landing page, `/json/*`, `/rbi/*`). **JS/TS client:** [`surfbird`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/surfbird) on npm — `new Surfbird(url,{token}).markdown(u)` etc., plus `sb.batch(action, urls)`. ## MCP (Model Context Protocol) Two ways to plug Surfbird into an MCP-capable agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, …): **A. `surfbird-mcp` — thin wrapper (recommended).** Exposes our REST actions as MCP tools — including `surf_markdown` and `surf_batch`, which stock browser MCPs don't have: ```json { "mcpServers": { "surfbird": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "surfbird-mcp"], "env": { "SURFBIRD_URL": "http://:8080", "SURFBIRD_TOKEN": "" } } } } ``` Tools: `surf_markdown` `surf_content` `surf_source` `surf_screenshot` `surf_pdf` `surf_evaluate` `surf_batch` `surf_health`. **B. `chrome-devtools-mcp` — full CDP surface.** Points straight at the proxied WebSocket (`/devtools/browser` passes through with Bearer auth) — more tools, more moving parts. See upstream docs; if your client can't send custom WS headers, run a `raw` image on a private network instead. **No MCP at all?** The REST layer is agent-friendly on its own — [`skills/surfbird/SKILL.md`](skills/surfbird/SKILL.md) is a drop-in skill that teaches any agent to drive it with `curl`. ## Agent plugins Purpose-built plugins that drive a Surfbird (or upstream Kitesurf) endpoint over CDP "like a person" — 28 `surfbird_*` tools each: tab management, navigation, semantic snapshots with element refs, click/fill/type, waits, JS evaluation, screenshots/PDF, console & network inspection, and WebMCP. Every agent session owns an isolated browser. - **[dsh-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf](https://github.com/terry2010/dsh-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf)** — for [DSH](https://www.deepseek.com/) agents; settings UI, encrypted token file, install via `dsh plugin install dsh-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf` - **[opencode-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf](https://github.com/terry2010/opencode-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf)** — for [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai/) (desktop app + TUI, with a built-in settings page/dialog); install via `opencode plugin add opencode-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf` - **[pi-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf](https://github.com/terry2010/pi-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf)** — for the [Pi](https://pi.dev/) coding agent; settings via `/surfbird-settings`, install via `pi install pi-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf` All three share the same host-independent CDP core and work against the `auth` image (Bearer token) or `raw` image (loopback/private networks only). ## Examples [`examples/`](examples/) — zero-dep Python client (`rss_to_markdown.py` builds a feed→markdown digest for LLM daily reports) and bash/curl scripts. ## Env | Var | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `SURFBIRD_TOKEN` | — | bearer token. **auth mode refuses to start without it** | | `SURFBIRD_PORT` | 8080 | proxy listen port | | `TLS_CERT_PATH` / `TLS_KEY_PATH` | — | mount certs → HTTPS. Want auto-ACME? put Caddy outside | | `REST_TIMEOUT_MS` | 120000 | per-action timeout | | `MAX_CONCURRENT_ACTIONS` | 2 | in-flight REST actions cap (each ≈ an engine isolate) | | `MAX_BATCH_URLS` | 20 | max urls per `/batch` call | | `MAX_BODY_BYTES` | 4194304 | REST request body cap (413 beyond) | | `SURFBIRD_INSPECTOR` | — | `1` opens the workerd debug inspector on :9229 (loopback, debugging only) | | `SURFBIRD_URL_ALLOWLIST` | — | comma-separated regexes — if set, only matching urls may be fetched | | `SURFBIRD_URL_BLOCKLIST` | — | comma-separated regexes — refuse matching urls (e.g. `169\.254\.\|,^http://localhost`) | | `ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_MS` | 120000 | startup wait for engine before proxy listens | | `SURFBIRD_MODE` | per target | `raw` / `auth` | `GET /health` is unauthenticated and returns 200 only when the engine answers — safe for LB probes. If either process dies, the container exits; use `--restart unless-stopped`. Bound to loopback above — reach a remote instance via SSH tunnel (`ssh -L 8080:127.0.0.1:8080 user@vps`) or a TLS reverse proxy. An exposed engine is a request-making machine on your VPS: token + firewall/TLS are the minimum, never expose `raw`. ## Building ```bash # A) full in-image build (needs ~4GB+ RAM, CI machines): docker build -f Dockerfile --target raw -t surfbird:raw . docker build -f Dockerfile --target auth -t surfbird:auth . # B) from a locally-built checkout (low-resource hosts): ./scripts/smoke-test.sh # stages a real ctx via tar (symlinks won't work — Docker can't COPY through them) # or manually: mkdir -p ctx/kitesurf && tar -C /path/to/kitesurf --exclude='*/node_modules' --exclude='*/.git' -cf - . | tar -C ctx/kitesurf -xf - cp -r proxy ctx/proxy && cp entrypoint.sh Dockerfile.prebuilt ctx/ docker build -f ctx/Dockerfile.prebuilt ctx -t surfbird:raw ``` Pin upstream: `--build-arg KITESURF_REF=` (Dockerfile A). Engine patches: drop `.patch` files into `patches/`, applied after clone. ## Limits (from upstream, not Surfbird's fault) - Experimental engine (Boa JS) — heavy-JS sites may render imperfectly - No touch/drag gestures, no video decode, no browser-style file downloads - DevTools frontend excluded from builds (China-network-safe); use CDP - Auth image adds a token gate — it is not a hardened multi-tenant boundary ## License Apache-2.0. Kitesurf © Cloudflare, Inc. See upstream [NOTICE](https://github.com/cloudflare/kitesurf/blob/main/NOTICE).
detail.readme_zh:
# Surfbird

[English](README.md) | **中文** **Kitesurf，自托管。** [Cloudflare Kitesurf](https://github.com/cloudflare/kitesurf) 的非官方 Docker 发行版——一个为 AI agent 而生的实验性浏览器引擎。 > 与 Cloudflare 无隶属或背书关系。Kitesurf 以 Apache-2.0 许可发布。 Kitesurf 解析 HTML、应用 CSS、执行页面 JavaScript 并渲染截图——没有 Chrome、没有浏览器容器——并且讲 CDP，Puppeteer/Playwright 照常连接。上游只支持本地 `wrangler dev` 或部署到 Cloudflare Workers（付费）。Surfbird 把它打包到任意 VPS 上运行。 ## 镜像 | 标签 | 内容 | 用途 | |---|---|---| | `terry2010/surfbird:raw` | 仅引擎，`:8787` | 本地 / 放在你自己的网关后面 | | `terry2010/surfbird:auth` | 引擎 + token 认证代理 + 可选 TLS，`:8080` | 一条命令即可对外 | | `terry2010/surfbird:latest` | = `:auth` | 方便的默认值 | 上游每发一个新 tag，镜像每天自动构建；也发布按 tag 固定的版本，如 `terry2010/surfbird:auth-2026.11.8`。 ## 快速开始 ```bash # raw —— 仅引擎，无认证。只绑回环/内网！ docker run -d -p 127.0.0.1:8787:8787 terry2010/surfbird:raw # auth —— 一条命令，token + REST actions docker run -d -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -e SURFBIRD_TOKEN=$(openssl rand -hex 24) terry2010/surfbird:auth ``` ## 用法 **CDP（Puppeteer / Playwright / chrome-devtools-mcp）：** ```js puppeteer.connect({ browserWSEndpoint: "ws://:8787/devtools/browser", // raw // 或 auth 镜像： browserWSEndpoint: "ws://:8080/devtools/browser", headers: { Authorization: "Bearer " }, }); ``` **REST（仅 auth 镜像）：** ```bash curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ -d '{"url":"https://zhuikan.com/repos/terry2010__surfbird","fullPage":true}' \ http://:8080/screenshot -o page.png curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ -d '{"url":"https://zhuikan.com/repos/terry2010__surfbird"}' \ http://:8080/markdown | jq -r .markdown ``` 端点：`POST /screenshot | /pdf | /content | /source | /markdown | /evaluate | /batch`（一个 action 作用于最多 `MAX_BATCH_URLS` 个 url，逐项返回结果）、`GET /health`、`GET /openapi.json`。`/content` 返回 JS 执行后的渲染 DOM；`/source` 返回原始响应体（即"查看源码"）。 其余路径全部透明代理到引擎（落地页、`/json/*`、`/rbi/*`）。 **JS/TS 客户端：** npm 上的 [`surfbird`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/surfbird)——`new Surfbird(url,{token}).markdown(u)` 等，外加 `sb.batch(action, urls)`。 ## MCP（Model Context Protocol） 两种方式把 Surfbird 接入支持 MCP 的 agent（Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf……）： **A. `surfbird-mcp` —— 薄封装（推荐）。** 把我们的 REST actions 暴露为 MCP 工具——包括 `surf_markdown` 和 `surf_batch`，这是原生浏览器 MCP 没有的： ```json { "mcpServers": { "surfbird": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "surfbird-mcp"], "env": { "SURFBIRD_URL": "http://:8080", "SURFBIRD_TOKEN": "" } } } } ``` 工具：`surf_markdown` `surf_content` `surf_source` `surf_screenshot` `surf_pdf` `surf_evaluate` `surf_batch` `surf_health`。 **B. `chrome-devtools-mcp` —— 完整 CDP 面。** 直连代理后的 WebSocket（`/devtools/browser` 带 Bearer 认证透传）——工具更多，部件也更多。见上游文档；如果你的客户端不能发自定义 WS 头，就在私网里跑 `raw` 镜像。 **不用 MCP 也行。** REST 层本身对 agent 就很友好——[`skills/surfbird/SKILL.md`](skills/surfbird/SKILL.md) 是一份即插即用的 skill，教任何 agent 用 `curl` 驱动它。 ## Agent 插件 专门构建的插件，"像人一样"通过 CDP 驱动 Surfbird（或上游 Kitesurf）端点——每个插件 28 个 `surfbird_*` 工具：标签页管理、导航、带元素引用的语义快照、click/fill/type、等待、JS 求值、截图/PDF、console 与 network 检查、WebMCP。每个 agent 会话独占一台隔离浏览器。 - **[dsh-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf](https://github.com/terry2010/dsh-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf)** —— 面向 [DSH](https://www.deepseek.com/) agent；带设置界面、加密 token 文件，`dsh plugin install dsh-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf` 安装 - **[opencode-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf](https://github.com/terry2010/opencode-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf)** —— 面向 [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai/)（桌面应用 + TUI，内置设置页/弹窗）；`opencode plugin add opencode-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf` 安装 - **[pi-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf](https://github.com/terry2010/pi-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf)** —— 面向 [Pi](https://pi.dev/) coding agent；`/surfbird-settings` 命令配置，`pi install pi-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf` 安装 三者共享同一套 host 无关的 CDP 核心，`auth` 镜像（Bearer token）和 `raw` 镜像（仅限回环/私网）都能用。 ## 示例 [`examples/`](examples/) —— 零依赖 Python 客户端（`rss_to_markdown.py` 把 RSS 源做成 markdown 摘要，供 LLM 日报使用）以及 bash/curl 脚本。 ## 环境变量 | 变量 | 默认值 | 含义 | |---|---|---| | `SURFBIRD_TOKEN` | — | bearer token。**auth 模式没有它拒绝启动** | | `SURFBIRD_PORT` | 8080 | 代理监听端口 | | `TLS_CERT_PATH` / `TLS_KEY_PATH` | — | 挂载证书 → HTTPS。想要自动 ACME？把 Caddy 放在外面 | | `REST_TIMEOUT_MS` | 120000 | 单 action 超时 | | `MAX_CONCURRENT_ACTIONS` | 2 | 并发 REST actions 上限（每个 ≈ 一个引擎 isolate） | | `MAX_BATCH_URLS` | 20 | `/batch` 单次最大 url 数 | | `MAX_BODY_BYTES` | 4194304 | REST 请求体上限（超出返回 413） | | `SURFBIRD_INSPECTOR` | — | `1` 在 :9229 打开 workerd 调试 inspector（仅回环，调试用） | | `SURFBIRD_URL_ALLOWLIST` | — | 逗号分隔的正则——设置后只允许匹配的 url | | `SURFBIRD_URL_BLOCKLIST` | — | 逗号分隔的正则——拒绝匹配的 url（如 `169\.254\.\|,^http://localhost`） | | `ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_MS` | 120000 | 代理开始监听前等待引擎就绪的时长 | | `SURFBIRD_MODE` | 随 target | `raw` / `auth` | `GET /health` 不需要认证，仅当引擎应答时返回 200——可安全用于 LB 探活。任一进程死掉容器就退出；用 `--restart unless-stopped`。 上面绑定的是回环——远程实例走 SSH 隧道（`ssh -L 8080:127.0.0.1:8080 user@vps`）或 TLS 反向代理访问。暴露的引擎是一台能在你 VPS 上发请求的机器：token + 防火墙/TLS 是最低要求，`raw` 永远不要暴露。 ## 构建 ```bash # A) 镜像内完整构建（需要 ~4GB+ 内存，CI 机器）： docker build -f Dockerfile --target raw -t surfbird:raw . docker build -f Dockerfile --target auth -t surfbird:auth . # B) 用本地已构建的 checkout（低配机器）： ./scripts/smoke-test.sh # 通过 tar 暂存真实 ctx（软链不行——Docker COPY 不跟随） # 或手动： mkdir -p ctx/kitesurf && tar -C /path/to/kitesurf --exclude='*/node_modules' --exclude='*/.git' -cf - . | tar -C ctx/kitesurf -xf - cp -r proxy ctx/proxy && cp entrypoint.sh Dockerfile.prebuilt ctx/ docker build -f ctx/Dockerfile.prebuilt ctx -t surfbird:raw ``` 固定上游：`--build-arg KITESURF_REF=`（Dockerfile A）。 引擎补丁：把 `.patch` 文件放进 `patches/`，在 clone 之后应用。 ## 限制（来自上游，不是 Surfbird 的锅） - 实验性引擎（Boa JS）——重 JS 站点可能渲染不完美 - 无触摸/拖拽手势、无视频解码、无浏览器式文件下载 - 构建中剔除了 DevTools 前端（对国内网络友好）；用 CDP - auth 镜像加的是 token 门——它不是强化的多租户边界 ## 许可证 Apache-2.0。Kitesurf © Cloudflare, Inc. 见上游 [NOTICE](https://github.com/cloudflare/kitesurf/blob/main/NOTICE)。
